name: VariableProximity-TS-TW
title: Variable Proximity
blurb: Each letter's font variations (weight, width) change based on cursor distance…
description: Renders text where each letter interpolates between two font-variation-settings based on distance from the cursor. Supports linear, exponential, or gaussian falloff. Requires a variable font supporting the specified axes.
use_when: An interactive heading wants to showcase a variable font with smooth, proximity-driven transformations.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices without cursor support or fonts without variable axes.
a11y: Visual letters are aria-hidden; readable text is in sr-only. Animation does not interfere with content.
